note: Modelled nominal or maximum catalogue dimensions of common commodity hardware, keyed by thread size. Each block names its public source; data/README.md holds the checking notes.

source: pitch: ISO 261 coarse series, as printed in the ISO 4762 table at https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/ISO/4762/

clearance_hole_medium: ISO 273:1979 medium series (H13), https://forgent3d.com/en/calculators/clearance-hole-chart (read from IS 1821:1987) and https://mechcodex.com/reference/metric-clearance-hole-sizes

ISO 4762.source: https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/ISO/4762/ (table according to ISO 4762: dk max, k max, s nominal), read 2026-11-24

ISO 7380-1.item: button head screw, hexagon socket; the standard covers M3 to M16
ISO 7380-1.source: https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/iso/7380 and ISO 7380-1:2022 Table 1 as printed in the preview at https://preview.sist.si/sist-preview/78699/a175805085534f98983d6c8aa583a5b0/ISO-7380-1-2022.pdf (dk max, k max, s nom), read 2026-11-24

ISO 4032.source: https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/ISO/4032/ (table according to EN ISO 4032: s nominal = max, m max), read 2026-11-24

ISO 7089.item: plain washer, normal series, product grade A (dimensions equal DIN 125 form A)
ISO 7089.source: https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/ISO/7089/ (table according to DIN 125: d1 min, d2 max, h between min and max), read 2026-11-24

DIN 653.item: knurled thumb screw, low (flat) type; M3.5 is a non-preferred size in the standard
DIN 653.fields: head_diameter_nominal, head_diameter_max, head_diameter_min, head_height_max, head_height_min, shank_diameter_max, shank_diameter_min
DIN 653.source: https://fasteners.eu/standards/din/653 (dimension table of DIN 653: dk nominal, max, min; k nominal = max, min; ds nominal = max, min; the label cells span columns, so values were read by column position from the size header row, M3, (M3,5), M4, M5, M6, M8), read 2026-11-27; cross-checked against https://boltport.com/standards/din-653 and https://engineeringhardware.com/guide/standard/din-653-din-653-knurled-thumb-screw-low-type

ISO 8734.item: hardened dowel pin, tolerance m6; the size key is the diameter in mm
ISO 8734.source: https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/ISO/8734/ (table according to ISO 8734: d, m6), read 2026-11-24

heat_set_insert.item: heat-set threaded insert, standard length, brass; no ISO standard defines it
heat_set_insert.source: CNC Kitchen standard-length inserts, store table of 2026-04-10, as listed at https://forgent3d.com/en/calculators/clearance-hole-chart (read 2026-11-24). Makers differ: ruthex gives M4 hole 5.6, M5 6.4, M6 8.0, M8 9.6 and M2.5 length 5.7; PEM IUTB gives M4 5.67, M5 6.43, M6 8.03. Use the datasheet of the insert bought.
